Figure 1: Overview of LabDex. LabDex is a hierarchical benchmark built on unified real-world and simulation platforms. It contains three task levels: Atomic Skills, Compositional Skills, and Long-Horizon Laboratory Workflows. The dataset is collected using a Franka Research 3 robot arm equipped with an XHand dexterous hand and covers a diverse set of laboratory objects.
